page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.8xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, delivering 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. Hardware instruction support includes AVX, AVX-512 (f and vnni), and AES acceleration. Memory density is substantial, featuring 256.0 GB of RAM configured at an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, backed by 35 MB of L3 cache. The instance includes no bundled local storage and operates with a 6 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, while containing zero dedicated GPUs.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent multi-threaded throughput balanced against modest single-core execution speeds. The instance achieves a PassMark CPU score of 23157.62 and a multi-core Geekbench score of 8927.0, placing overall multi-core computation in the middle 50% category. In contrast, single-core metrics fall into lower percentiles, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 1018.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1106.99. Memory benchmarks show uncached read throughput at 99.19 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 49.44 GB/sec, supporting steady data access across its large capacity.

In operational testing, the instance exhibits reliable capabilities for distributed caching and enterprise workloads, sustaining 22.7 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and 16.87 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. CPU-based machine learning inference achieves 80.05 tokens per second generation speed on smaller 135M models, tapering to 10.34 tokens per second on 7B models. From a resource perspective, the high RAM allocation relative to compute capacity makes it cost-effective for large in-memory frameworks that do not require high single-thread clock rates.

Given its 1:8 core-to-memory ratio, absence of bundled local disks, and moderate network baseline, the primary architectural tradeoff is reliance on external networked block storage for non-volatile persistence. Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.8xlarge is best matched for large-scale in-memory caching layers such as Redis, enterprise databases requiring large buffer pools, in-memory analytics engines, and memory-intensive ETL tasks.
